items.prompt: Reuleaux / IFToMM pairs: revolute, prismatic, helical, cylindrical, spherical, planar, plus higher pairs (cam-follower, gear mesh, rolling contact). Which pairs have a mechlib semi-primitive, which are only implied by a larger assembly, and which pair-level generators are missing?
items.title: Lower and higher kinematic pairs

items.prompt: Crank-rocker, double-crank, double-rocker, parallelogram, deltoid, change-point, Grashof vs non-Grashof, Roberts/Chebyshev cognates, Hoecken. What does four_bar plus the named linkages already cover, and what named 4-bar still needs its own pose+kit?
items.title: Planar four-bar and cognates

new_categories.name: leg_mechanisms
new_categories.why: Walking-leg kits (Klann, Jansen, plantigrade, walking-beam) are a distinct agent job from general bar linkages. four_bar's usecase currently dumps 'walking-robot legs' onto a generic crank-rocker. A movements-group category would let gallery cards and search_use_cases hit the right primitive.

items.prompt: Watt and Stephenson six-bar topologies, Klann, Theo Jansen, strandbeest-class, walking-beam / pumpjack, plantigrade. These are the usual 'missing from a 4-bar kit' request. Which are semi-primitive enough for mechlib vs a finished walking robot?
items.title: Six-bar, walking, and animal-motion linkages

items.prompt: Peaucellier, Hart, Watt, Chebyshev, Scott-Russell, Hoecken, Roberts, Evans, grasshopper, Tusi couple, Cardanic motion, trammel of Archimedes, Sarrus (already spatial). Catalog each; mark exact vs approximate; say which pose APIs exist.
items.title: Straight-line and inversor linkages

new_categories.name: spatial
new_categories.why: Bennett, spherical 4-bar, 5-bar, delta forearm, and UPS strut are a different agent job from planar bar linkages and from hinge/ball joints. four_bar's usecase does not mention concurrent axes or overconstrained spatial loops; joints currently dumps wrists onto ball_socket_joint and gimbal_rings. A movements-group shelf lets search_use_cases hit the right primitive without implying a finished robot.

items.prompt: Bennett, spherical four-bar, 7R, Agile Eye, delta, Stewart/Gough, 5-bar planar robot, serial RRR arm primitive, roll-pitch-roll wrist, Hoberman / deployable. Filter hard: finished robot chassis is out of scope; a parametric delta-joint kit or spherical 4-bar pose may not be.
items.title: Spatial, spherical, and parallel mechanisms

items.prompt: Plate, face, barrel, heart, snail already exist. Still in the class: globoidal / Ferguson indexing cam, conjugate / desmodromic pairs, inverse cam, linear / wedge cam, cylindrical face-groove, barrel indexer, Geneva variants (internal, spherical), star wheel vs Maltese, intermittent gears, ratchet-index tables.
items.title: Cam types and intermittent motion

items.prompt: Spur, internal, herringbone, bevel, worm, cycloidal, harmonic, rack, sector, planetary already exist. Survey helical (single), face/crown, hypoid, spiroid, crossed-helical, lantern/pin, noncircular/elliptical, magnetic, nutating/wobble, compound trains, automotive differential, sun-and-planet, hypoid-ish printable stand-ins. Which are FDM-real?
items.title: Gear and reduction families

new_categories.name: brakes
new_categories.why: A brake grounds a shaft; a clutch joins two shafts. Winch hold, hoist, park, and Prony are a different agent job from dog/freewheel/limiter. Catalog has a clutches shelf and no brakes shelf. Band, expanding-shoe, and parking-pawl would live here; the missing-categories slice can rank the shelf.

items.prompt: Dog, freewheel, torque limiter, compliant clutch, Hirth exist. Missing class? Cone, multiplate, wrap-spring, sprag, roller-ramp, centrifugal, magnetic, fluid coupling. Brakes as a category: band, shoe, disc/caliper, over-center park. Which are printable semi-primitives vs bought hardware?
items.title: Clutches, brakes, and overrunning

items.prompt: Oldham, jaw, beam, Hooke, double Cardan, tripod exist. Survey Rzeppa/ball CV, Tracta, Thompson, Schmidt, bellows, disc/membrane, grid, chain coupling, homokinetic joints. Note which have pose laws in-module (needed to animate) vs display-only kits.
items.title: Shaft couplings and CV joints

new_categories.name: constant_force
new_categories.why: Negator tape, constant-force flexures, and gravity arms are a machinery class of their own: they source a flat force/torque, they are not a screw. The flexure and clockwork slices will name the compliant and horological members; this slice owns the tape-on-drum actuator. missing-categories can rank the shelf.

items.prompt: Lead screw, differential screw, screw jack, scroll, archimedes, telescoping stage, linear way exist. Survey ball screw, roller screw, scotch-yoke (have), rack (have), wedge/inclined plane, hydraulic/pneumatic cylinder geometry, voice-coil stand-in, tape measure / constant-force Negator, cable cylinder.
items.title: Screws, jacks, and linear actuators

items.prompt: Cross flexure, bistable beam, flexure stage, leaf/coil/wave/torsion/spiral springs, kerf, auxetic exist. Survey cartwheel hinge, living hinge as API, lamina emergent, constant-force compliant, contact-aided, ORBITAL / remote-center, notch hinge primitives, split-tube flexure, tape-spring hinge.
items.title: Compliant mechanisms and flexure joints

new_categories.name: clockwork
new_categories.why: Escapements, going barrels, remontoires, and stop-work are a machinery class. Indexing (geneva, star wheel) is intermittent motion from a continuous crank; clockwork is a feedback oscillator. The gallery currently files escapement under indexing. missing-categories can rank the shelf.

items.prompt: Escapement, fusee, spiral power spring, ratchet exist. Survey deadbeat vs recoil vs detent vs coaxial vs gravity, going barrel, remontoire, maintaining power, count wheel, striking (probably product), stackfreed, constant-force mechanisms, gravity arm.
items.title: Clockwork, escapements, and energy storage

items.prompt: Timing, V-belt, idler, tensioner, winch, fusee, grooved drum exist. Survey block-and-tackle, Weston differential pulley, capstan, self-tailing winch, cam/clam cleat, rope clutch, fairlead, turning block, Spanish windlass, belt CVT variable pulley, cable carrier is already drag_chain.
items.title: Pulleys, cables, tackle, and textile hardware

items.prompt: Gerotor, external gear, peristaltic, spool, check, hose barb exist. Survey vane, lobe, screw, piston/swash (swash_plate exists), diaphragm, centrifugal impeller, needle/ball/gate/butterfly valves, pressure relief, shuttle, manifold block, Tesla valve, pulsatile.
items.title: Pumps, valves, and fluid machines

items.prompt: Toggle clamp, eccentric cam clamp, collet, bellows cup, iris, kinematic coupling, dock, leveller exist. Survey parallel jaw gripper as semi-primitive, angular gripper, latch/pawl catch, over-center hood latch, draw latch, vises, soft jaw, magnetic chuck, vacuum cup families, tool-changer plate (if primitive).
items.title: Grippers, chucks, latches, and workholding

items.prompt: Plain bushing, printed ball, thrust, linear way, oring, labyrinth, gasket exist. Survey crossed-roller, dovetail way (ydovetail is a cutter), V-way, air bearing (out?), magnetic bearing (out?), needle roller stand-in, shaft seal / lip, piston ring, wiper.
items.title: Bearings, ways, and seals

items.prompt: Look at the live CATEGORIES table and name mechanism classes that are not a current shelf: brakes, dampers/dashpots, differentials, parallel robots, walking, cable/tendon, constant-force, magnetic drives, traction/CVT, brakes vs clutches split, end-effectors vs grippers, tooling/ATC, heat? (out). For each proposed NEW category: is it a real machinery class, FDM-printable, semi-primitive, and not a finished product? Rank the ones that should become a module.
items.title: Whole categories mechlib does not name

items.prompt: Read gallery/build_gallery.py ANIMATE and the 'deliberately left out' comment. For every multi-body movement demo with no animation: is the reason still true, or can a pose law be added so the gallery can play it? Rank the highest-value pose-law additions. Do not propose animating static adjustments (eccentric_idler_mount).
items.title: Mechanisms that exist but cannot play

new_categories.name: dampers
new_categories.why: Energy dissipation is a machinery class. No current shelf. First kits: orifice_dashpot, rotary_vane_damper, friction_snubber, inerter. Brakes ground a shaft; dampers are two-terminal rate elements.

items.prompt: First-principles slice invented after the original 18 queued. Survey viscous dashpot, rotary vane damper, friction snubber, inerter, tuned-mass damper, elastomer bumper, eddy/magnetic (out?), hydraulic shock product. Which are printable semi-primitives vs bought hardware?
items.title: Dampers, dashpots, and energy sinks

items.prompt: Invented first-principles slice. Watt flyball, Porter, Proell, Hartnell, spring/pickering, hit-and-miss, centrifugal (clutch exists), isochronous, dashpot-damped. Survey 507 governors. Which are printable semi-primitives vs engine products?
items.title: Governors, speed regulators, and flyballs

items.prompt: Invented first-principles slice. Spatial already named Hoberman angulated-scissor and Bennett/Bricard rings. Flexure named LET and tape-spring. items.prompt: Invented first-principles slice. 507 has shuttle 397, warp-dressing 383, spinning throstle 496. Survey lock-stitch (needle + shuttle/hook), needle bar, take-up, heddle, reed, rapier, Jacquard hook. Semi-primitive cells only, not a sewing machine or a loom.
